name: Mid-morning
say: The trades already up at 14 knots from east-north-east, the sun still low over Virgin Gorda. The time to start a long beat

name: Early afternoon
say: Fifteen knots with gusts to 20, and the shoals at their brightest under a high sun

name: Late afternoon
say: The breeze holding as the light goes gold. Be on a mooring by six: night falls fast here

name: Christmas winds
say: The reinforced trades of midwinter: 20 knots and more in the channel, with harder gusts off the hills. Reef before you leave
